spec.body_markdown: ## Parallelogram Law\n\nPlace A and B tail-to-tail from the same point, then complete the parallelogram. The diagonal drawn from that shared tail is R = A + B. The other diagonal of the parallelogram equals A - B. This gives the same resultant as the triangle law, just built differently, useful when two forces act at the same point at the same time.
